question: The Ghostly Debugger: You are coding at 2 AM in a dark room. Suddenly, a ghost appears behind you, but it will only leave if you explain what 'Wi-Fi' is using only dance moves. Show us the dance.

The Wrong Group Chat: You just sent a highly confidential, incredibly roasting meme about your strict professor... directly into the official college group chat where they are an admin. You have 30 seconds to explain yourself before they read it. Act out your reaction.

The Alarm Disaster: It's 8:25 AM. Your semester-end external exam starts at 8:30 AM. You just woke up, your roommate locked you in the room from the outside, and your phone has 1% battery. How do you escape?

The No-Tech Desert Island: You get shipwrecked on a deserted island with only three items: a broken laptop charger, an empty plastic bottle, and a selfie stick. How do you survive a tiger attack using only these?

The Ultimate Power Cut: You are defending your final-year project to an extremely strict panel of judges. Right as they say 'Show me the live demo,' the entire college campus loses electricity. Act out how you 'manually' simulate the website working.

The Alien Interpreter: Aliens land on the college ground. They don't speak English or Tamil, but they are pointing a laser gun at the Principal. They will only spare the campus if you convince them you are friendly using only dramatic facial expressions and gibberish.

The Time Loop Lecture: You are stuck in a time loop. Every time you try to walk out of the classroom door, you teleport right back to the front row, and the professor asks you the same question. How do you break the loop? Act out your 5th attempt.

The Accidental VIP: You walk into a luxury tech conference looking for the free snacks, but the organizers mistake you for the billionaire keynote speaker and push you onto the stage in front of 1,000 people. You have to give the opening 30 seconds of a speech on 'The Future of Space Tomatoes.' Go!

The Sentient Smartphone: Your phone has gained consciousness, locked its own screen, and is holding your gallery photos hostage unless you perform a heartfelt, emotional apology song to it. Sing/act the apology.

The Runaway AI Robot: You built a cleaning robot, but it went rogue and is now trying to sweep all the students out of the college corridor. How do you physically tackle and 'shutdown' this tiny but aggressive robot? Act it out.

The Forgotten Birthday: It's your best friend's birthday right now. You completely forgot, you have zero money, and you are standing in front of them empty-handed. Invent and pitch a 'super exclusive, invisible gift' to save your friendship.

The WiFi Hostage: The college canteen uncle changes the Wi-Fi password. He will only give it to you if you dramatically act out a scene from a blockbuster movie where you are begging for your life—but replace the word 'life' with 'data pack.'

The Invisible Professor: You are secretly eating a massive plate of biryani in the back row during a lecture. Suddenly, the professor walks right up to your desk and asks you a question. You have a mouth full of food. Act out how you answer without getting caught.

The Zombie Lab: A chemical spill in the chemistry lab turns half your class into slow-moving zombies. You are trapped in the computer lab. How do you use keyboard wires and mouse pads to defend your territory?

The Missing Team Member: It's presentation day. Your main presenter decided to skip college to watch a movie. You have never read the slides. Act out your opening line to the judges when they ask, 'Where is the rest of your team?'

The Autocorrect Nightmare: You just sent a text to your strict father saying 'I am dating a gang of international smugglers' instead of 'I am doing a group study with my smart friends.' He is calling you right now. Pick up the phone and explain.

The Gravity Anomaly: Suddenly, gravity in the seminar hall reverses, but only for you. Everyone else is fine, but you are sticking to the ceiling. Act out how you try to casually take notes without anyone noticing.

The Broken Chair: You sit down on the stage to start your speech, and the leg of the chair immediately snaps. You have to finish your entire 30-second speech while pretending you are sitting comfortably on an invisible chair.

The Copy-Paste Curse: You copied an assignment from the smartest kid in class, but you accidentally copied their name and their personal diary entry at the bottom. The teacher calls you to the staff room. How do you explain this 'coincidence'?
The Silent Film Interview: You are at a job interview, but you suddenly lose your voice. You must explain why you are the hardest-working person in the room using only silent-film style over-acting.
